typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DataLoadErrorMessage as string (),
	ErrorFile as string (),
	ErrorListRecipients as string (),
	ErrorMessage as string (),
	ErrorPath as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	Market as string (),
	NonCalllistJobs as integer (),
	QuarantineFile as string (),
	QuarantinePath as string (),
	TemplateFile as string (),
	TemplatePath as string (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		MbrKey as string,
		CallList as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive({Convert.MbrKey} = MbrKey,
		{Convert.Calllist} = toString(CallList)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		CALLLIST_OVERRIDE_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALLLIST_OVERRIDE_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLLIST_OVERRIDE_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD = {Convert.Calllist},
		CALLLIST_OVERRIDE_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = {Convert.MbrKey})) ~> OLEDBDestination
